blocks.text: Object-Oriented Programming is a method of designing programs using objects and classes. Each object represents a real-world entity with specific properties and behaviors. Classes act as templates for creating multiple objects with similar characteristics. OOP emphasizes encapsulation, inheritance, and polymorphism to manage data and behavior efficiently. This approach helps in modeling real-world problems in programming.

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text: Create a chart comparing procedural programming and OOP. Have students explain scenarios where OOP is more useful.
